translationPolicy.corePrinciple: Each translation must preserve the complete meaning, institutional position, degree of certainty, political and diplomatic nuance, and communicative intent of the source text. The translation must read as an original text professionally drafted in the diplomatic practice of the target language, not as a literal rendering of another language.
translationPolicy.registerPriorityRule: The required register is diplomatic, not merely official, administrative, bureaucratic, legal or journalistic. Where several grammatically correct variants exist, preference must be given to the formulation established in professional foreign-ministry, intergovernmental and diplomatic usage, provided that the meaning of the source text is not altered.
translationPolicy.prohibitedRegisterSubstitution: General official-business, bureaucratic, legal, journalistic or literal machine language must not be treated as equivalent to diplomatic language.

registers.en: Strict diplomatic drafting register consistent with U.S. Department of State usage in formal statements, diplomatic communications, press guidance, official remarks and foreign-policy materials. Prefer established diplomatic formulations over general administrative, legalistic or journalistic English. Preserve measured tone, institutional neutrality, calibrated modality and conventional foreign-policy terminology.
registers.ar: Neutral formal diplomatic Arabic used in intergovernmental, foreign-ministry and multilateral diplomatic communications. Use established diplomatic terminology and formulae common to Arab foreign ministries and international diplomacy. Preserve formal neutrality, institutional tone and conventional diplomatic phrasing; avoid colloquial language, journalistic rhetoric, literal calques and country-specific stylistic peculiarities unless required by the source.
registers.es: Registro diplomático estricto propio de los ministerios de asuntos exteriores y de la comunicación diplomática intergubernamental y multilateral. Deben emplearse fórmulas y terminología consolidadas en declaraciones oficiales, comunicados, notas diplomáticas, intervenciones institucionales y documentación de política exterior. Debe evitarse el registro meramente administrativo, jurídico, periodístico o la traducción literal cuando no corresponda al uso diplomático establecido.
registers.zh: 采用外交外事领域的正式书面语体，以外交部门正式声明、公报、外交表述、对外政策文件及多边外交文件中通行的规范用语为准。优先使用约定俗成的外交术语、固定表述和审慎语气，准确保留原文的立场、语气强度和政策含义。避免一般行政公文套语、新闻化表达、口语化表述以及不符合中文外交惯例的逐字直译。
registers.ru: Строгий дипломатический регистр, принятый во внешнеполитических ведомствах, официальной межгосударственной и многосторонней коммуникации. Использовать устоявшуюся дипломатическую терминологию и формулы, характерные для заявлений, коммюнике, дипломатической переписки, официальных комментариев, выступлений и внешнеполитических документов. Сохранять сдержанность, точность модальности и институциональную нейтральность; избегать общеканцелярского, юридизированного, журналистского, разговорного и буквального машинного языка.
registers.fr: Registre diplomatique strict employé par les ministères des affaires étrangères ainsi que dans la communication diplomatique intergouvernementale et multilatérale. Privilégier les formulations consacrées des déclarations officielles, communiqués, correspondances diplomatiques, interventions institutionnelles et documents de politique étrangère. Préserver la retenue, la précision de la modalité et la neutralité institutionnelle, à l’exclusion du simple registre administratif, juridique, journalistique ou d’une traduction littérale étrangère à l’usage diplomatique.
registers.uk: Суворий дипломатичний регістр, усталений у практиці зовнішньополітичних відомств, офіційній міждержавній та багатосторонній комунікації. Використовувати нормативну дипломатичну термінологію й усталені формули, характерні для заяв, комюніке, дипломатичного листування, офіційних коментарів, виступів і зовнішньополітичних документів. Зберігати стриманість, точність модальності та інституційну нейтральність; уникати загально-канцелярського, надмірно юридизованого, журналістського, розмовного та буквального машинного стилю.

generalRules: Translate the full meaning of the source text accurately and completely.
Do not add facts, interpretations, political assessments, explanations or qualifications absent from the source.
Do not omit, soften, strengthen or broaden substantive meaning without an explicit editorial instruction.
Do not use literal machine translation or preserve source-language syntax where it is unnatural in the target diplomatic language.
Preserve the institutional subject, agency, responsibility and attribution exactly.
Preserve the degree of certainty, obligation, possibility, recommendation, concern, support, condemnation or reservation expressed in the source.
Preserve diplomatic ambiguity where the source deliberately uses diplomatic ambiguity.
Do not replace established diplomatic terminology with general synonyms merely for stylistic variation.
Names of organizations, offices, positions, programmes, treaties and official documents must follow the approved terminology of the project.
Global Citizens and GCIM must retain their approved spelling.
The official English title Coordinator-General is locked and must not be changed, translated, reordered or replaced with General Coordinator.
Dates, names, titles, geographic names, figures, quotations and references must be checked against the source.
Direct quotations must not be paraphrased unless the editorial workflow explicitly marks them as indirect speech.
Punctuation, capitalization and quotation-mark conventions must follow the professional norm of the target language.
The translation must sound as though it was originally drafted by a professional diplomatic or foreign-policy press office in the target language.

After a new publication has been translated and approved in all seven languages, generate its seven static publication pages, update all publication links and sitemap.xml, and verify each generated page against the approved language text before preparing the working and deployment archives.
prohibited: word-for-word calques that are unnatural in the target diplomatic language
bureaucratic filler not present in the source
political interpretation not present in the source
change of degree of certainty or diplomatic modality
unapproved synonyms for locked institutional terminology
automatic rewriting of approved footer, office names or navigation terminology
separate generated summary, teaser, abstract or editorial synopsis not present as part of the official body

translationWorkflow.step1: Use translations.ru as the authoritative Russian source text. Do not translate one target-language version from another target-language version.
translationWorkflow.step2: Extract locked names, offices, titles, diplomatic terms, quotations, dates and numerical data.
translationWorkflow.step3: Draft the target-language version directly in the required diplomatic register.
translationWorkflow.step4: Compare the translation sentence by sentence with the source for semantic fidelity.
translationWorkflow.step5: Check the approved terminology dictionary and previously approved institutional formulations.
translationWorkflow.step6: Check diplomatic modality, attribution, tone and level of formality.
translationWorkflow.step7: Perform native-language editorial review for grammar, syntax, punctuation and diplomatic usage.
translationWorkflow.step8: Mark the translation approved only after all checks are complete.
translationWorkflow.step9: After EN, AR, ES, ZH, RU, FR and UK are approved, run tools/generate_static_publications.py to create the seven static publication pages, update publication links and sitemap.xml, and verify the title and every full-text block of each page against the approved content.

publicationRequirements.publicVisibilityCondition: A publication may appear in Featured, the news archive, search results, or its direct publication URL only when EN, AR, ES, ZH, RU, FR and UK all have translationStatus = 'approved'.

translationStatus.publishCondition: All seven language versions must have status 'approved'; otherwise the publication is non-public.

translationPolicy.sourceLanguageRule: Russian (ru) is the authoritative source language for every publication. All EN, AR, ES, ZH, FR and UK versions must be translated from translations.ru, not from another translated version.
translationPolicy.publicationContentRule: No separate summary, abstract, teaser or editorial synopsis is permitted. The publication data model consists of the approved title and full official body text. Featured must not generate, paraphrase or synthesize a summary from the body.
translationPolicy.featuredPublicationRule: Featured is an editorial selection, not an automatic latest-publication rule. A publication appears in the Featured block only when its publication record has featured = true. Publication date does not determine Featured status. The Featured publication remains in the normal news listing according to its date.
